annotations.title: Spiegel mit & ohne Rahmen finden Sie bei Höffner online

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog** for home/catalog shopping: Spiegel was a major U.S. mail-order catalog retailer, but the classic Spiegel home catalog shopping experience is **no longer operating as it once did**. Historical references note Spiegel sold apparel, home furnishings, housewares, and more through its catalog. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you’re looking to **shop home items online today**, try similar online home retailers/catalog-style stores such as:

- **Wayfair** – furniture, décor, rugs, bedding, lighting  
- **Pottery Barn** – classic home furnishings and décor  
- **West Elm** – modern furniture and home décor  
- **IKEA** – budget-friendly furniture and home goods  
- **Home24 / Höffner / Westwing** – if you’re in Europe or searching “Spiegel” as the German word for “mirror” ([hoeffner.de](https://www.hoeffner.de/garderoben-spiegel?utm_source=openai))

Also, note: **“Spiegel” means “mirror” in German**, so many search results for “Spiegel home shopping” will show mirrors for sale rather than the former Spiegel catalog.
